feeds.term: ("Alzheimer Disease"[Mesh]) AND (amyloid OR tau OR neuroinflammation OR APOE OR microglia) AND (mechanism OR pathology OR pathogenesis)

feeds.term: (Alzheimer) AND ("p-tau217" OR "plasma biomarker" OR "blood biomarker" OR "amyloid PET" OR "GFAP") AND (diagnosis OR detection OR screening)

feeds.term: (Alzheimer OR dementia) AND (prevention OR diet OR exercise OR "cognitive reserve" OR lifestyle OR "physical activity") AND (cohort OR "risk factor" OR longitudinal)

feeds.term: ("Alzheimer Disease"[Mesh]) AND ("Review"[Publication Type]) AND (overview OR introduction OR "current understanding" OR primer OR basics)

drug.title: Baseline plasma C1q and C3 as potential biomarkers for lecanemab efficacy and ARIA risk in early Alzheimer's disease.
drug.zh: 基线血浆C1q与C3水平可预测仑卡奈单抗疗效及ARIA风险。

drug.title: In brief: Subcutaneous lecanemab (Leqembi Iqlik) for initial treatment of Alzheimer's disease.
drug.journal: The Medical letter on drugs and therapeu
drug.zh: 皮下莱卡奈单抗初始治疗阿尔茨海默病，疗效与静脉给药相当且注射更便捷。

drug.title: Anti-amyloid treatment in Alzheimer disease: updated implications for patients with cerebral amyloid angiopathy and other cerebrovascular conditions.
drug.zh: 抗淀粉样单抗治疗需警惕合并脑淀粉样血管病患者的卒中诊治与抗栓风险。

drug.title: Conformational modulation and inhibition of lysozyme amyloid fibrillation by lanthanum-doped red carbon dots: a multispectroscopic, morphological, and molecular simulation study.
drug.journal: Spectrochimica acta. Part A, Molecular a
drug.zh: 镧掺杂碳点通过非催化位点结合溶菌酶，以氢键和范德华力抑制淀粉样纤维化。

drug.title: From public preferences to clinical tasks in anti-amyloid therapy for Alzheimer's disease.
drug.zh: 日本患者对仑卡奈单抗的预期获益远超实际疗效，临床需全程管理该期望落差。

drug.title: Clinical immunology lessons from failed α-Synuclein and Tau immunotherapies: A roadmap for combination strategies in Alzheimer's disease.
drug.zh: α-突触核蛋白与tau疫苗失败揭示四大免疫学教训，指明AD联合治疗新方向。

drug.title: Beyond Amyloid: Systemic and Brain Frailty as Determinants of Response to Anti-Amyloid Therapy in Alzheimer's Disease-A Conceptual Review.
drug.zh: 系统及脑衰弱决定抗淀粉样治疗获益，评估时应超越淀粉样病理。

drug.title: Exosome-Based Therapeutics in Alzheimer's Disease: Translational Perspectives Beyond Conventional Therapies.
drug.zh: 外泌体疗法凭借血脑屏障穿透性与多靶点递送优势，有望突破现有AD治疗瓶颈。

mech.title: Effects of Qi-fu-yin on Improving Cognitive Impairment and Reducing Cellular Senescence in the Brains of 5xFAD Mice.
mech.zh: 启宫饮改善5xFAD小鼠认知障碍，并减轻脑内细胞衰老。

mech.title: Natural microbial enrichment modulates microglial states and transcriptional programs relevant to Alzheimer's disease.
mech.zh: 室内“再野化”重塑小胶质细胞状态，或缓解阿尔茨海默病相关神经炎症。

mech.title: Tau-associated neuronal loss in the intermediate nucleus of the human hypothalamus, a putative VLPO analog, in progressive supranuclear palsy and Alzheimer's disease.
mech.zh: PSP与AD中下丘脑中间核tau蛋白沉积及神经元丢失程度不同，且AD中随Braak分期加重。

mech.title: MCH-Guard: Multimodal machine learning framework for risk stratification of cerebral microhemorrhage risk in the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative.
mech.zh: 多模态框架MCH-Guard可高精度预测ADNI人群脑微出血风险，仅用临床史即可达AUC 0.72。

mech.title: Alterations of gut microbiota in Down syndrome and their association with Alzheimer's disease.
mech.zh: 唐氏综合征患者肠道菌群组成改变，特定菌属与阿尔茨海默病血浆标志物及认知衰退相关。

mech.title: Psychological impacts of APOE genotype disclosure among Latinos in New York City: a randomized controlled trial.
mech.zh: APOE基因型披露未显著增加拉丁裔人群心理困扰，安全性良好。

mech.title: Human amniotic mesenchymal stromal cell-derived extracellular vesicles reprogram microglia and prevent neurodegeneration in experimental models of Alzheimer's disease.
mech.zh: 人羊膜间充质干细胞胞外囊泡经鼻给药重编程小胶质细胞，改善阿尔茨海默病认知与突触损伤。

mech.title: Size-tailored nanoparticle-antibody conjugates overcome hepatic sequestration in Alzheimer's disease treatment.
mech.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of S
mech.zh: 尺寸定制纳米抗体偶联物绕过肝脏截留，经肠道排Aβ改善阿尔茨海默病。

dx.title: More efficient screening for preclinical Alzheimer's clinical trials using mixture of experts.
dx.zh: 混合专家模型结合血浆生物标志物可显著提升临床前阿尔茨海默病试验的筛查效率。

dx.title: Alterations of gut microbiota in Down syndrome and their association with Alzheimer's disease.
dx.zh: 唐氏综合征患者肠道菌群改变与阿尔茨海默病血浆标志物及认知衰退相关。

dx.title: Blood biomarkers of brain damage in Transient Ischemic Attack: the role of plasma NfL and GFAP.
dx.zh: 血浆NfL和GFAP可区分MRI阴性TIA患者与健康人，提示TIA存在亚临床脑损伤。

dx.title: Are infraslow oscillations the missing link between sleep and Alzheimer's?
dx.zh: 慢波睡眠纺锤波超慢振荡幅度降低或为阿尔茨海默病早期睡眠相关生物标志。

dx.title: Cerebrospinal fluid and plasma biomarkers in idiopathic normal pressure hydrocephalus: comparison with Alzheimer's and Parkinson's diseases.
dx.zh: iNPH患者脑脊液Aβ42/Aβ40比值及tau蛋白谱与AD、PD显著区分，提示其病理机制独立于典型神经退行性病变。

dx.title: Blood-based biomarkers of Alzheimer's disease and neurodegeneration in an indigenous African cohort using both Simoa and NULISA platforms.
dx.zh: 非洲本土队列中血浆p-tau217、NfL和GFAP随认知恶化阶梯性升高，支持跨种族AD血液诊断价值。

dx.title: Comparison of baseline characteristics between cognitively normal and mild cognitive impairment and association of white matter hyperintensity trajectories with diagnostic outcomes, cognition, and amyloid-β protein: A longitudinal study.
dx.zh: 基线WMH轨迹可独立预测认知正常或轻度障碍者的阿尔茨海默病进展及Aβ沉积风险。

dx.title: Peripheral blood microarray-based transcriptomic and epigenetic analyses identify immune, inflammation, and metabolic dysregulation in Alzheimer's disease.
dx.zh: 外周血多组学揭示AD免疫激活、炎症及代谢抑制，且受APOE ε4显著影响。

prev.title: Demographic and clinical influences on emotion prosody recognition.
prev.zh: 情绪韵律识别能力受年龄、教育及临床状态显著影响，可作为阿尔茨海默病风险筛查的数字化认知指标。

prev.title: Age-friendly environments and incident motoric cognitive risk syndrome in older adults: A prospective cohort study.
prev.zh: 老年友好环境可显著降低老年人运动认知风险综合征的发病风险。

prev.title: Psychological impacts of APOE genotype disclosure among Latinos in New York City: a randomized controlled trial.
prev.zh: 拉丁裔人群获知APOE基因型后心理未受负面影响，支持安全披露。

prev.title: Cross-sectional relationships between memory scores and neurodegeneration biomarkers in patients with suspected cognitive impairment.
prev.journal: Journal of clinical and experimental neu
prev.zh: 记忆评分与神经退行生物标志物在疑似认知障碍患者中呈横断面关联。

prev.title: Reasons for Surgical Delay in HIP Fracture: What Can We Do From the Emergency Room?
prev.zh: 急诊室识别髋部骨折手术延迟主因，痴呆患者占比高且延迟增加死亡率与住院时长。

prev.title: Association between oxidative balance score and cardiovascular risk factors, aging, and incidence of dementia risk score: A prospective cohort study.
prev.zh: 氧化平衡评分越低，中年人群晚年痴呆风险越高。

prev.title: Exposome influences: a multi-omics perspective on the combined toxic effects of pharmaceuticals and personal care products in Alzheimer's disease.
prev.zh: 多组学揭示药品与个人护理品联合暴露经表观组修饰加剧阿尔茨海默病风险。

prev.title: Physical inactivity in preclinical Alzheimer's disease: Risk factor, early symptom, or both?
prev.zh: 临床前阿尔茨海默病中体力活动减少或为tau相关早期症状，而非单纯风险因素。

intro.title: More efficient screening for preclinical Alzheimer's clinical trials using mixture of experts.
intro.zh: 抽血查几个指标，就能提前筛出可能得老年痴呆的人，帮新药试验更快找到合适的志愿者。

intro.title: The Crosstalk Between Diabetes and Alzheimer's Disease: A Molecular Perspective.
intro.zh: 糖尿病和老年痴呆可能是一根藤上的两个瓜，控好血糖或许能帮大脑防糊涂。

intro.title: Anti-amyloid treatment in Alzheimer disease: updated implications for patients with cerebral amyloid angiopathy and other cerebrovascular conditions.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是治老年痴呆的新药可能让脑血管变脆弱，提醒有中风风险的人用药前要查脑部血管，防止治疗时出意外。

intro.title: Human Stem Cell-Derived Models of the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimmune System.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是用干细胞造出迷你人脑模型，帮我们看清老年痴呆时脑内“清洁工”细胞怎么出错，为将来找药和早发现提供新路子。

intro.title: Overview in Electrochemical and Electrical Biosensors for Determining Blood Protein Biomarkers of Alzheimer's Disease.
intro.zh: 这篇文章讲的是用一滴血、靠小设备测出几个关键蛋白，提前发现老年痴呆风险，让普通人不用做腰穿或昂贵脑扫描就能早筛查。

intro.title: Microglia in Alzheimer's disease: Insights into disease progression and therapy.
intro.zh: 大脑里的清洁工（小胶质细胞）一旦吃油吃出毛病，就会加速老年痴呆，搞清这点能帮我们找新药。

intro.title: Brain organoids in Alzheimer disease and related tauopathies: Challenges and opportunities for translational readiness.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是用“迷你人脑”替代小鼠来研究老年痴呆，帮新药测试更靠谱，减少临床试验白费功夫。

intro.title: Menopausal insomnia as a modifiable node of dementia risk: Mechanistic insights and intervention strategies.
intro.zh: 更年期睡不好，可能悄悄增加以后得老年痴呆的风险，但睡好了就能提前防住它。
